head: 81a96f63f10a43af1dc2d92215173e8829a500e4
title: Stripe renewal payments are dropped because the first invoice of the subscription is already paid

bugs.note: The invoice id in the subscription metadata is always the invoice that started the subscription. The already-paid skip in the invoice.paid handler looks at that invoice for every event, not only for the initial payment, so each renewal returns early once the first invoice is paid: Stripe charges the card, no funds are added and the renewal invoice stays unpaid until the service is suspended.
